text_block_list.text:
While walking along the riverbank with 
Yamanin Zephyr, a familiar figure caught 
my eye.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, that's...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looks like it's not here. Shall we 
look near the academy?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Please go ahead and return to the 
dorms. I will continue the search on my 
end."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still... it's a precious handkerchief your 
grandmother gave you, right? In that case, 
please let me help look for it too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good day. Are the two of you searching for 
something lost?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... It's Ruby's handkerchief, a 
red one embroidered with a rose in gold 
thread. Zephyr, have you guys seen it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably... the answer is complete 
stillness.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind is quite strong today, so perhaps 
a mischievous gust carried it away.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It seems finding it will be 
quite difficult now. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Items lost to the whims of the wind... 
can surely be found by following the 
breeze."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Zephyr, where are you going...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Is the wind leading to... you? Little 
White Bird, Little White Bird. Have you 
seen a bright red handkerchief?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Asking a swan a question...? Ah, 
Zephyr-san! Please wait...!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"So Mr. Pitch-Black came riding in on this 
wind, did he?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Now it's a crow...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I feel the wind ascending to the sky, but 
I see no sign of the handkerchief... The 
remnants of the wind on which Mr. 
Pitch-Black rode—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"It appears this path leads to Mr. Bee's 
nest. Pardon the intrusion, then."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Buzzy Mr. Bee...!? Look out, Zephyr!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah.... Round and round... we've made 
it to the academy... Where is Zephyr――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miss Ruby. Is that handkerchief caught in 
the tree over there the one you're looking 
for?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...! It appears so.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it's quite high up. At that 
rate—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Kh, Zephyr-san?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho... Feeling the wind 
while climbing a tree is truly quite 
pleasant, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Here you are, Miss Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...... ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft... Ahaha! You really are amazing, 
Zephyr!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To forge ahead without hesitation, and 
effortlessly resolve things we thought 
were impossible like a gust of wind...
choice_data_list: Zephyr's a capable girl, after all.
That shows in your running, too.
That shows in your running, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To forge ahead without hesitation, and 
effortlessly resolve things we thought 
were impossible like a gust of wind...
choice_data_list: Zephyr's a capable girl, after all.
That shows in your running, too.
That shows in your running, too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. I am the type that can manage.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I feel you went a bit too far with your 
wild antics, but... Thank you for your 
assistance. Regarding the reward for this 
occasion—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What blows in from the east... is quite 
the unusual breeze, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That free-spirited nature is one of 
Zephyr's charms, too.

Yamanin Zephyr felt a sense of relief, 
knowing she was blessed with such an 
understanding friend despite her own 
easygoing pace.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I will simply stay true to my own wind. 
Wherever the wind blows, infinitely free, 
infinitely fast.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a fierce wind. We'd better 
make sure we don't get blown away either.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...? Is that the hint of a whirlwind 
coming from the two of you?

K.S.Miracle and Daiichi Ruby. Seeing how 
they recognize and elevate one another, I 
found myself looking forward to what lies 
ahead.
